name: branding-urbanist-type-and-lime-palette-with-pill-weights
title: Giant 'Urbanist' specimen with lime weight pills and stacked rounded colour bars in teal, lime and gradient
whatItIs: A pale grey sheet with a huge navy geometric sans 'Urbanist' with three lime pills (Light, Regular, Bold) and four long rounded colour bars labelled with hex codes: dark teal, lime, a warm yellow-to-green gradient, and two neutrals.
whatItMeans: Fresh and confident; big type and generous colour bars read as a calm system.
techniques: Show the typeface at giant scale.
Stack colours as long rounded bars.
Include a gradient swatch as a brand asset.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule naming a font weight.
A long rounded swatch labelled with its code.
A swatch showing a colour blend.
A typeface name at huge size.
